MOAI_0_0.text: The Moai looks away in quiet disapproval.

MOAI_0_1.text: The Moai whispers a single word: 'Yikes.'

MOAI_0_2.text: The Moai coughs awkwardly and avoids eye contact.

MOAI_1_0.text: The Moai judges you... and finds you mildly acceptable.

MOAI_1_1.text: The Moai whispers a single word: 'Meh.'

MOAI_1_2.text: The Moai shrugs. A fair and balanced judgment.

MOAI_2_0.text: The Moai nods approvingly. A rare honor.

MOAI_2_1.text: The Moai whispers a single word: 'Nice.'

MOAI_3_0.text: The Moai does a backflip. Nobody will ever believe you.

MOAI_3_1.text: The Moai whispers a single word: 'Sex'.

MOAI_3_2.text: The Moai gives you a thumbs-up. You didn’t even know it had thumbs.

SHADY_GUY_1.text: "You got money? I got... not-stolen goods."

SHADY_GUY_10.text: He smells like burnt sugar and a little bit of ozone.

SHADY_GUY_11.text: The Shady Guy pulls out a deck of cards, shuffles them, and then eats one. He refuses to elaborate.

SHADY_GUY_12.text: You feel like if you asked him about taxes, he would immediately evaporate.

SHADY_GUY_13.text: He leans in close and whispers: "You have beautiful eyes"

SHADY_GUY_2.text: "Between you and me... the Moai's got nothing on my deals."

SHADY_GUY_3.text: "The more you buy, the less I have to carry. Help a guy out."

SHADY_GUY_5.text: "Hey, don't tell the Moai about this, okay?"

SHADY_GUY_6.text: "You smell that? It's the smell of an amazing deal."

SHADY_GUY_7.text: "I don't need this many fingers. Take one."

SHADY_GUY_8.text: Every item is suspiciously warm, as if he was just holding it under his coat.

SHADY_GUY_9.text: You blink. When you open your eyes, he's somehow closer.
